arms.title: Knife with iron blade, leather bound handle and sheath. Leaf-shaped blade with grip wrapped in leather and with knotted leather strips; tang with rounded tip protrudes from the end of the grip; blade decorated with grooveson both sides; leather sheath with loop handle wrapped with leather thong. Leather worn and damaged; end of grip flattened.

Spear of Shelakai type, with a wooden shaft and metal spearhead. The spearhead is large and leaf shaped, with a midrib and ridges following the outside edge; short split socket with a circular cross-section. The shaft has a circular cross-section with natural knots present, and a hexagonal butt weight made of metal.

Throwing spear with a wooden shaft and metal blade. The blade is leaf shaped with a midrib and slightly angular shoulders; short split socket. The shaft has a circular cross section and flat terminal; there are several splits in the wood.

Surat el Meiram. Throwing spear with a wooden shaft and metal spearhead. The blade is leaf shaped, with midrib and ridges following the outside edge. The shank has two circular sections, decorated with grooves and zigzags; the socket has a circular cross section. The shaft has a circular cross-section and a coil of metal at the terminal. Used by Sultan Ali Dinar's relatives.

Spear with a wooden shaft and metal spearhead. The blade is long and leaf shaped with a midrib and decorated with grooves around the rib. The split socket is short with a circular cross-section, and is decorated with three grooves. The shaft has a circular cross-section.
